name: graff
description: graff, a code map for Claude Code: an MCP server that answers where a name is defined, what reaches it and what it reaches, what a change would touch, what a file defines and what matters most in a git worktree's Rust, Nix, Bash, Python, C and Markdown, each answer with file:line ranges within a token budget; a hook that says so when a session starts in a worktree with code graff reads, and nothing anywhere else; and one that names the session's folder to each call, so a session that enters a worktree is answered for it.
